source_label.Description: Channel label exactly as in data.label of the release

number_on_amplifier.Description: channelInfo.numberOnAmplifier of the release (amplifier input of the first contact of the pair, as stored)

n_epochs_rejected.Description: Number of epochs flagged as rejected for this channel in data.RjEpochChannel

rejected_epochs.Description: Epoch numbers (1-based, = events.tsv epoch) flagged as rejected for this channel in data.RjEpochChannel (authors' labels; data are NOT removed)
